subject: GovCloud private offer renewal and chargeback alignment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@novamed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GovCloud private offer renewal - draft PO attached

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the continued partnership. Attached is a draft PO for our GovCloud/private-offer renewal (term: 12 months) covering regulated workloads. We need to align on the acceptance window and invoicing cadence so our finance team can route the PO through procurement and chargebacks. Key asks from our side:

- Formal private offer flow for GovCloud (DocuSign + AWS Marketplace private offer acceptance)
- Invoice tranches mapped to our quarterly chargeback windows (we prefer 3 tranches)
- A small capacity uplift possibility (20% headroom) effective Aug 1, pending acceptance
- Evidence that the GovCloud instance will be isolated and covered by the same audit scope (SOC reports)

Attached: Novamed_PO_DRAFT_20270418.pdf (pdf)

Can you confirm the expected timeline for private offer activation once we sign? We need to present that to legal and procurement by EOW.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, Novamed Health
procurement@novamed.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud private offer renewal - draft PO attached

Hi Samir — thanks for the PO and the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (billing & marketplace ops) and Soojin (legal handoff) to coordinate the steps you asked for. Quick notes: 

- We can support a GovCloud private offer via AWS Marketplace; typical activation after DocuSign is 2-3 business days but GovCloud sometimes needs an extra day for the marketplace team to process the SKU mapping. We'll confirm internally.
- We can structure 3 invoice tranches; Kimberly will propose dates that align with your chargeback quarters.
- Capacity uplift: we can provision a 20% headroom as a provisional uplift with a firm start date of 2027-08-01; we'll confirm pricing for the uplift and whether it is prorated.
- SOC/audit evidence: I'll attach the SOC pointer (or provide link) once Soojin confirms the current scope for GovCloud specific controls.

Next steps: 
1) Kimberly to propose tranche dates + a sample invoice schedule (by Tue 4/19).
2) Soojin to review PO redlines and confirm if any legal edits are required for the private offer route (by Wed 4/20).
3) If PO is clean, Samir to countersign via DocuSign and forward envelope link back here.

Samir — can you confirm procurement's billing contact and whether you need a consolidated invoice PDF for your AP system?

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success (Renewals & Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: GovCloud private offer renewal - draft PO attached

Irene / Soojin — quick internal sync on billing/chargeback options for Novamed. Attached is a proposed chargeback mapping that aligns 3 tranches with their fiscal quarters. Highlights: 

- Tranche 1 (50%) invoice on activation (target 2027-05-03)
- Tranche 2 (25%) invoice 2027-08-01 (aligned to Aug quarter)
- Tranche 3 (25%) invoice 2027-11-01
- For the 20% capacity uplift starting 2027-08-01 we will issue a prorated invoice for the remainder of the term on Tranche 2.
- We can provide a single consolidated invoice PDF per tranche suitable for upload to Novamed's AP system.

I added a sheet with mapping to Novamed's cost centers (chargeback_mapping_novamed.xlsx). If Soojin signs off on redlines, we can attach the finalized invoice schedule to the DocuSign envelope so procurement has the exact dates.

Also linking the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/records/12345/DEAL-D-2027-NOV-001

Kimberly
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@novamed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace-support@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud private offer renewal - draft PO attached

Irene / Kimberly / Soojin — thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement has reviewed and we are moving forward. Two updates from our side: 

1) We attached the signed PO (Signed_PO_Novamed_20270421.pdf) and sent the DocuSign envelope. DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/0f3a9b2c
2) We confirm the billing contact is AP Team (ap@novamed.com). They prefer consolidated tranche PDFs.
3) On capacity: Novamed would like the 20% uplift to be a soft guarantee for the first 90 days, then auto-convert to permanent if usage sustains >85% for two consecutive months. Is that workable?
4) SLA exception: because the workload is regulated and routed to GovCloud us-gov-west-1, we need a written note that the GovCloud instance will be within the same monitoring and incident channels; also requesting a 24x7 escalation contact for the first 30 days after activation.

Attached: Signed_PO_Novamed_20270421.pdf (pdf)

Please confirm the private offer activation ETA once DocuSign completes and whether the marketplace team needs anything else from Novamed.

Thanks,
Samir

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novamed.com>, AP Team <ap@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace-support@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: GovCloud private offer renewal - draft PO attached

Samir — excellent, appreciated. Confirming next steps & timeline: 

- We received the DocuSign envelope link and the signed PO. I'll trigger the private-offer activation with AWS Marketplace ops this afternoon. Typical GovCloud private offer activation: 1-3 business days after we submit the signed envelope and SKU mapping. I'll flag that we need GovCloud SKU routing explicitly to us-gov-west-1 to avoid extra rework.
- Chargeback / invoicing: Kimberly will generate consolidated tranche PDFs and send to ap@novamed.com the day Tranche 1 settles (target 2027-05-03).
- Capacity uplift: We can implement the 20% soft guarantee for 90 days (2027-08-01 to 2027-10-01). If sustained usage >85% for two consecutive months, we'll auto-convert the uplift to permanent and issue a mid-term amendment documenting the change in capacity and pricing. I'll have Legal (Soojin) prepare a short amendment template that we can attach to the deal.
- SLA / escalation: We will provide a dedicated escalation contact (24x7 shift) for the first 30 days post-activation. Contact details will be emailed to your security and operations points of contact once the activation date is confirmed.

Action items assigned: 
- Kimberly: finalize tranche invoice PDFs and send to ap@novamed.com on Tranche 1 settlement.
- Soojin: draft a 1-page amendment for the 20% provisional uplift and GovCloud SLA addendum (draft by 2027-04-28).
- Irene: submit private offer activation with AWS Marketplace ops and confirm activation ETA (today).

I will update the HubSpot deal record and attach the signed PO and invoice schedule. Thanks everyone — we'll loop back if Marketplace ops needs more info.

Best,
Irene
